menstrual.text: 🩸 Rest is not weakness. It's recovery. Listen to your body today.
🌸 You're shedding your lining and still showing up. That's metal.
💪 Even on low energy, you're here. Keep it light and controlled.
🌙 The moon is dark, but she still pulls the tides. Rest, then rise.
😤 Men will never know what it's like to function while bleeding. You're already winning.
🕯️ Light a candle, breathe, and move gently. You deserve kindness.
🧘‍♀️ Today's workout is optional. Being kind to yourself is mandatory.
💧 Hydrate, rest, and know that every day you show up is a victory.
🐢 Slow and steady wins the race – especially this week.
🎗️ Your body is doing important work. Support it, don't punish it.

follicular.text: ⚡ Your energy is coming back. Time to wake up those muscles.
🌱 Spring is inside you. New growth, new strength. Let's plant some PRs.
🏋️‍♀️ Estrogen is your friend. Use it to push a little harder today.
💃 Feel that? It's your superpower waking up. Go crush it.
📈 Your hormones are climbing. So can your weights.
🚀 Time to launch into higher intensity. You've got this.
🌸 Fresh energy, fresh goals. Let's build something great.
💪 Your body is ready to perform. Trust it.
🌊 Ride the wave of rising strength. Don't fight it.
🎯 Set a small challenge today. You'll surprise yourself.

ovulatory.text: 💪 You're at your strongest. PR or bust. Let's go!
⚡ Peak power unlocked. Today you're a superhero.
🏆 This is your week. Own every rep, every set, every breath.
🔥 Your hormones are singing. Time to make some noise.
📊 Your body is optimized for output. Use it wisely.
🎯 Set a PR today. Your body is ready.
💥 Explosive power, sharp mind. This is your moment.
👑 Queens don't wait for perfect conditions. They create them.
🌞 You're at your peak. Shine bright.
🏅 Today's workout could be legendary. Go find out.

luteal.text: 🌸 Your energy is dipping. That's okay. Focus on form, not weight.
🧘‍♀️ Progesterone says slow down. Wisdom says listen. Move mindfully.
😤 You're still here even when you'd rather nap. That's grit.
💪 Moderate effort today. Tomorrow is another chance to push harder.
🍫 Chocolate and gentle movement. That's the plan.
🌊 Ride the wave, don't fight it. Lower intensity, higher intention.
🛋️ Some days you conquer the world. Other days you conquer the couch.
🎗️ Your body is preparing for something big. Be patient with it.
💤 Rest is not laziness. It's part of the cycle.
🐢 Slow and steady still wins. You're still moving.

any.text: 🌊 Like the moon, you have phases. Unlike the moon, you can still lift.
👑 Queens track their cycles because they run their kingdom.
💅 While men argue about reps, you're syncing with the universe.
🍫 Chocolate + movement = the only formula that matters today.
🌈 Every cycle is a new beginning. What will you create today?
🎯 Your body knows the way. Follow it.
💪 Strength isn't linear. Neither is your cycle. Both are beautiful.
🧠 You're learning to read your body's language. That's wisdom.
✨ You are not broken. You are cycling.
🌺 Honor your rhythm, and it will honor you.
